items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1983-05-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...that might be people like Raymond or Armand Hogg around Raymond Burke...

ctx.x: Johnny Wiggs I heard seems to me perhaps at a jazz club at a New Orleans jazz club meeting at uh at uh the St Charles Hotel I don't remember I don't remember whether Raymond was with him there or not I know I heard I also heard Johnny seems to me in the back room of the New Orleans record shop

uh yeah well I I can remember going back there and that might be people like Raymond or Armand Hogg around Raymond Burke uh and various other people from time to time anyway uh uh you knew Rolfson Crawford yes did he give you any advice on photography or did you ever talk to him about photography

a little bit not much uh it seems to me and I may be confusing this situation with another but it seems to me when when I asked him about composition uh that he suggested I look at as many uh paintings and photographs as I could but that's about the only advice that I remember ever hearing from Rolston
